principles: Use original products with product ID, acquisition time and footprint whenever scene-level products are available.
Never label a mosaic, derived index or reconstructed image as one original observation.
Preserve source, licence, age, resolution, cloud and NoData metadata.
Use the 26-direction geometry as a synchronization grid, not as a claim that satellites are stationary.
Keep credential-gated downloads on server or Jupyter processing nodes; never expose provider secrets in GitHub Pages.

providers.notes: International discovery backbone through CMR/IDN and CEOS standards.
